verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say you can give it plain-language requests, such as tickets or a Slack thread about a bug, and have it implement new features or reproduce and fix bugs with full repo access. Refactors and migrations imply multi-file edits, but no doc explicitly says a single plain-language request produces coordinated changes across multiple files. Hands-on community reports say it delivers real work but adds extraneous changes beyond the task that can break other things. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of coordinated multi-file edits, independent corroboration that changes stay scoped to the described task.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: Ask Devin to tackle Linear/Jira tickets, implement entirely new features, repro and fix bugs, build internal tools, and more!

The cloud session gets its own VM with a shell, browser, and full repo access
